settings.subheading: Guaranteed Christmas Delivery with Zero Surprise Customs Fees at Your Door.
settings.guarantee_pill_text: 🎄 2026 Holiday Guarantee: Order by Dec 15 for arrival before Christmas Eve
settings.ddp_body: Unlike ordinary dropshipping stores where international customers get hit with unexpected 20–30% VAT bills and courier clearance admin fees upon delivery, FROSTBYTE operates 100% on a Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) basis.
settings.guarantee_box_text: All local import duties, VAT/GST, and customs brokerage fees are calculated and completely covered at checkout. You and the gift recipient will never be asked to pay another cent when the carrier rings the doorbell.
settings.insurance_body: Every single holiday parcel is dispatched with an international tracking number and full door-to-door transit insurance. If a parcel is delayed past Dec 24, we will immediately refund your shipping cost and issue a $25 store credit voucher.
